note: City of Oxford park at Napawalla Road and West Clark Street; grassy sites under scattered trees. The bathrooms and showers (south end) are open April to mid-October. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city page: $15 electric / $3.50 primitive, FCFS only, 14-day max, showers, dump; cleared the derived Apr 15-Oct 15 season (it is the shower-house season); amperage not stated by the city.
flags: Hookups (stored electric 50, water true, derived from note prose) left as stored: the city page says only 'Electric hook up' and 'Water is available throughout the park', no amperage and nothing about water at the site. The 30/50 A in the old note has no source on the city page.

$15 rate: posted on the live city page read 2026-11-06 (footer 'Copyright 2026'); the page itself carries no rate date. The $3.50 primitive rate is for tent/primitive camping; $15 electric is the RV base.
Presence (local): City of Oxford's own parks page with the City Office phone (620) 455-2223 (stored phone confirmed). Google Maps: 'Napawalla Park' 5.0 (4 reviews), 315 W Clark St, no phone listed.

Pin 37.2731,-97.1724 sits at the park's north-east corner by the internal drive; imagery shows the treed park but I could not resolve RV pads, so no pin move proposed (Google's park pin 37.27170,-97.17358 is ~185 m SW, also inside the park).
Waterfront 'not waterfront' consistent: a wooded creek channel runs ~150 m west of the park drive; no water at the sites.
Lead: the same city page says 'Cave Park does allows primitive camping at no cost for one night only' (river access park) - primitive, one night, not an RV campground lead.
